name: Hotel Désirée
beschreibung: Hotel Désirée is located in the Tiroler Alpen and is surrounded by quiet, natural surroundings. The mountain landscape offers an extensive network of hiking trails in summer and direct access to the region's ski areas in winter. The hotel's amenities include a wellness area with sauna and relaxation room as well as a restaurant serving regional cuisine. The rooms have a balcony and mountain views. The stay is suitable both for active holidaymakers and for those seeking relaxation.
